title: Iowa Judge Dismisses Trump’s Lawsuit Against The Des Moines Register
summary: The suit challenged a poll that showed Trump trailing Kamala Harris in the final weeks of the 2024 race. A judge warned that similar legal challenges could have a chilling effect on news reporting.
